suggested_change: Criterion 1/3: Remove dual requirement for both 'explicit statement of absence' AND passive observation—choose one standard. Criterion 4: Define 'concrete next step' as requiring either contact name OR timeline, not both mandatorily when one is genuinely unknown. Criterion 5: Clarify whether Partial status requires evidence advocates are NOT internally selling (active disconfirmation) or only lack of confirmation they ARE (passive absence)—current rubric conflates these.
